name: Disneyland Little Red Wagon World-Famous Hand-Dipped Golden Corn Dog
whyItWorks: World-famous hand-dipped all-beef frankfurter coated in sweet, smooth cornmeal batter and fried golden. The cornmeal is finely ground with zero whole corn kernels or abrasive hulls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hand-Dipped Corn Dog with sliced apples or bag of potato chips; dip in mild yellow mustard.
watchOuts: Deep-fried batter is rich; eat slowly
